description: Source code for Triton embedding configuration and response transformation, including error handling and shape splitting logic.

classes.name: TritonEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Triton embedding transformations, including request/response handling and environment validation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for TritonEmbeddingConfig, currently does nothing.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns an empty list, indicating no supported OpenAI parameters.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Triton embedding parameters, currently returns optional_params unchanged.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates environment settings, currently returns an empty dict.

methods.name: transform_embedding_request
methods.description: Transforms input data into a Triton-compatible embedding request payload.

methods.name: transform_embedding_response
methods.description: Processes raw HTTP response to extract embedding data and populate the model response.

methods.description: Returns a TritonError exception for given error details.

methods.name: split_embedding_by_shape
methods.description: Splits a flat list of floats into sublists based on the provided shape, assuming shape length of 2.
